text:
Who

are you

you who are born

in the neighboring room

so plain inside my room

that I can hear the womb

as it opens and the shadow advancing

over the ghost and the child descending

behind the wall thin as a goldfinch bone

in the bleeding room of hidden birth

for the burning and turning of time

the footprint of the human heart

does not venerate baptism

but only the shadow

when it blesses

the wild

creature

translation.title: Who Are You
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the birth-room immediacy and the narrow, breath-broken lineation of the Spanish text.
